name: Remove Fatigue
body:
School conjuration (healing); Level alchemist 2, bloodlord 2, cleric/oracle 2, druid 2, inquisitor 2, paladin 1, shaman 2

Casting Time 1 round

Components V, S, M (a pinch of smelling salts)

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)

Target one creature

Duration instantaneous

Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistances yes (harmless)

You remove any fatigue suffered by the target or improve the exhausted condition to fatigue.
